newsitem.title: UK: Burton eases after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Burton eases after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in Burton Group were indicated lower in pre-market dealings on Thursday after the UK retailer issued a trading statement.
Dealers said the company's statement was broadly in line with expectations, but a share price rally in recent sessions had left it vulnerable to profit-taking.
At 0813 GMT, the shares were quoted at 159-3/4p, down 2p.
Burton Group said its sales were up 11.1 percent in the 20 weeks ended January 18, while gross margins rose by one percent over a year ago

Burton shares have climbed by about 5.4 percent over the last month. They rose yesterday in a generally weaker retail sector after official figures showed that UK retail sales fell 0.8 percent last month.
"They've had a good runup recently and I think people are just ready to take some profits," said one dealer. "I couldn't see anything wrong in their statement."
